잔.forms: native number + 잔: 커피 한 잔 · 물 두 잔
잔.e: 커피 한 잔 = a cup of coffee.
잔.t: 한잔하다 means 'to have a drink', usually alcohol: 오늘 한잔해요!

아이스크림.x: It's hot, so I want to eat ice cream.
아이스크림.e: From English 'ice cream', said in five syllables: a-i-seu-keu-rim.

요리사.x: My older brother is a hotel chef.

보내다.x: I sent a birthday present to my friend.
보내다.e: Two uses: 문자를 보내다 = send a text; 시간을 보내다 = spend time.
보내다.t: 주말 잘 보내세요! = 'Have a nice weekend!'

얼마나.forms: 얼마나 + adjective: 얼마나 걸려요?, 얼마나 커요?
얼마나.x: How long does it take from home to school?
얼마나.t: 얼마예요? asks a price; 얼마나 asks degree: 얼마나 걸려요? = How long does it take?

그래서.forms: starts a sentence: A. 그래서 B. · within a sentence use -아/어서
그래서.ex: 어제 너무 피곤했어요. 그래서 일찍 잤어요.
그래서.x: I was very tired yesterday. So I went to bed early.
그래서.e: From 그러하다 (to be so) + -어서 (so). 그래서요? = And then? / So?

행복.ex: 가족과 함께 보내는 시간이 저에게는 가장 큰 행복이에요.
행복.x: Time with my family is my greatest happiness.

낚시.x: My father goes fishing at the river every weekend.
낚시.e: Related to 낚다 'to hook, to catch (a fish)'.
낚시.t: Slang: 낚시 also means clickbait, and 낚였어요 means 'I got fooled (hooked).'

치우다.m: to clean up, to clear away, to put away
치우다.x: I cleaned up the living room before the guests came.
치우다.t: 치우다 means removing clutter or dishes; 청소하다 means actually cleaning dust and dirt.

깨지다.m: to break, to be broken, to shatter
깨지다.x: The glass fell on the floor and shattered.

캔.x: Please put empty cans out for recycling.
캔.t: In apartment recycling areas, cans go in the bin marked 캔류 'cans'. Common combos: 캔 커피 'canned coffee', 캔 맥주 'canned beer'.

문제점.ex: 이 계획의 문제점이 무엇인지 이야기해 봅시다.
문제점.x: Let's talk about what the problems with this plan are.
문제점.e: -점 = point or aspect, reused often: 문제점, 장점, 단점.
문제점.t: Pronounced [문제쩜]; 문제점 is a specific flaw, while 문제 is the problem itself.

관계자.ex: 경찰 관계자는 사고 원인을 조사 중이라고 밝혔습니다.
관계자.x: A police official said they are investigating the cause of the accident.
관계자.e: -자 = person: literally 'a person with a connection' to the matter.
관계자.t: The sign 관계자 외 출입 금지 on doors means 'Authorized personnel only.'

종양.x: The test results showed a small tumor.
종양.t: 양성 종양 is a benign tumor; 악성 종양 is a malignant one.

학업.ex: 그는 일과 학업을 함께 하느라 바빠요.
학업.x: He's busy juggling work and school.

명작.x: This novel is a classic that has been loved for a long time.

합법.ex: 이 나라에서는 길에서 술을 마시는 것이 합법이에요.
합법.x: In this country, drinking alcohol on the street is legal.
합법.t: Pronounced [합뻡] — ㅂ becomes tense after ㅂ.

국방.ex: 정부는 올해 국방 예산을 크게 늘렸습니다.
국방.x: The government greatly increased the defense budget this year.
국방.t: Pronounced [국빵] — the ㅂ after ㄱ becomes tense.

엉뚱하다.ex: 그 친구는 가끔 엉뚱한 질문을 해요.
엉뚱하다.x: That friend sometimes asks off-the-wall questions.
엉뚱하다.t: Can be playful and positive: 엉뚱한 상상 means quirky, creative imagination.

응용하다.m: to apply (knowledge, a technique), to put to practical use
응용하다.ex: 배운 내용을 실제 생활에 응용해 보세요.
응용하다.x: Try applying what you learned to real life.
응용하다.e: Literally 'use in response' — adapting what you know to a new case.

집착하다.m: to be obsessed with, to cling to
집착하다.ex: 너무 결과에만 집착하면 과정을 즐길 수 없어요.
집착하다.x: If you're too obsessed with results, you can't enjoy the process.
집착하다.e: Literally 'grasp and stick' — can't let go.

팽팽하다.x: The game between the two teams was neck and neck to the end.
팽팽하다.e: Doubled syllable for something stretched tight; also used for smooth, firm skin.

손을 보다.forms: 손을 봐요 · 손을 봤어요 · 손봐 줄게요
손을 보다.m: to fix, to touch up, to repair; (rough slang) to teach someone a lesson
손을 보다.ex: 고장 난 의자를 아버지가 손을 봐 주셨어요.
손을 보다.x: My dad fixed the broken chair for me.
손을 보다.e: Literally 'to see to something with one's hands.'

입양.x: That couple adopted a daughter last year.
입양.e: Literally 'enter to be raised' — a child entering a new family.
입양.t: Pronounced [이뱡]: the ㅂ carries over into the next syllable.

공직.x: He held public office for thirty years.

석학.ex: 세계적인 석학들이 모여 기후 문제를 논의했습니다.
석학.x: World-renowned scholars gathered to discuss climate issues.

포개다.m: to stack, to pile (one on another), to lay one on top of another
포개다.ex: 다 쓴 접시는 여기에 포개 놓으세요.
포개다.x: Please stack the used plates here.
포개다.t: 포개다 = laying flat things neatly on each other; 쌓다 = piling things up in general.

엄연히.m: clearly, undeniably, as a plain fact
엄연히.ex: 허락 없이 남의 물건을 가져가는 것은 엄연히 도둑질이에요.
엄연히.x: Taking someone's things without permission is plainly stealing.
엄연히.e: Literally 'solemnly so': a fact standing firm.
엄연히.t: Used to stress a fact that someone is ignoring or denying.

무혐의.m: no charges, lack of evidence of guilt (decision not to prosecute)
무혐의.ex: 검찰은 증거가 부족해서 그를 무혐의로 처리했습니다.
무혐의.x: Prosecutors cleared him of charges due to insufficient evidence.
무혐의.t: Common in news as 무혐의 처분 'decision not to indict'; it is not the same as a court's 무죄 'not guilty'.

엠바고.m: (news) embargo, hold on publication until a set time
엠바고.ex: 그 발표는 내일 오전까지 엠바고가 걸려 있어요.
엠바고.x: That announcement is under embargo until tomorrow morning.
엠바고.e: From English 'embargo'; in Korean it almost always means a press embargo, not a trade ban.

영생.ex: 옛날 황제들은 영생을 얻으려고 불로초를 찾았어요.
영생.x: Ancient emperors searched for the herb of immortality to gain eternal life.

나르시시즘.x: Some argue that social media feeds narcissism.
나르시시즘.e: From English 'narcissism'; the many ㅡ vowels break up the English consonant clusters.

전구증상.x: A headache can be a warning sign of a migraine.
전구증상.t: Homonym warning: 전구 also means 'light bulb' (電球); context makes it clear.

마취제.x: An anesthetic was given to the patient before surgery.

공평무사.m: fairness and impartiality, with no personal bias
공평무사.x: A judge must always rule fairly and impartially.
공평무사.e: Literally 'fair and even, without private interest'.

준법정신.m: law-abiding spirit, respect for the law
준법정신.x: Following traffic rules is a basic part of respecting the law.
준법정신.t: Pronounced [준뻡쩡신]: 법 is tensed in 준법 [준뻡], and ㅈ after ㅂ becomes tense.

횡령하다.ex: 회계 담당자가 회사 자금을 횡령해 구속됐습니다.
횡령하다.x: The accountant was arrested for embezzling company funds.
횡령하다.e: Literally 'take sideways' — diverting money that isn't yours.
횡령하다.t: Pronounced [횡녕하다] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

어르다.forms: 얼러요 · 얼렀어요 · 어를 거예요 · 어르세요 (르 irregular)
어르다.m: to soothe, to humor (a baby); to coax
어르다.x: The mom gently soothed the crying baby.

공탁.m: deposit with the court, legal deposit
공탁.ex: 피고인은 피해자를 위해 법원에 손해배상금을 공탁했습니다.
공탁.x: The defendant deposited damages with the court for the victim.
공탁.e: Literally 'offer and entrust' — you hand money to the court when the other side won't accept it.
공탁.t: Used with 하다; in criminal cases 공탁 often aims to show remorse for a lighter sentence.

리스크.ex: 이 투자는 수익이 높지만 리스크도 큽니다.
리스크.x: This investment has high returns, but the risk is also big.
리스크.e: From English 'risk.' The final k gets an extra vowel: ri-seu-keu.
